gloss: to match; to coincide; to be in accord

definitions.gloss: to match; to coincide; to be in accord
definitions.explanation: For two things to agree, correspond, or be in alignment with each other.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}が{合致|がっち}した。
{条件|じょうけん}に{合致|がっち}する{候補者|こうほしゃ}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: We are looking for candidates who match the requirements.

examples.japanese: {調査|ちょうさ}{結果|けっか}は{事前|じぜん}の{予測|よそく}とほぼ{合致|がっち}しており、{仮説|かせつ}が{正|ただ}しかったことが{確認|かくにん}された。
examples.english: The survey results largely coincided with the prior predictions, confirming that the hypothesis was correct.

notes:
A formal word used when two things correspond or align. Common in academic, legal, and business writing. In everyday conversation, {合|あ}う or {一致|いっち}する are more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意見|いけん}が{合致|がっち}する: opinions agree
- {条件|じょうけん}に{合致|がっち}する: to match conditions
- {方針|ほうしん}と{合致|がっち}する: to be in line with policy
- {目的|もくてき}に{合致|がっち}する: to match the objective
- {基準|きじゅん}に{合致|がっち}する: to meet standards

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一致|いっち}する: to match, to agree — more common, nearly synonymous
- {合|あ}う: to match, to fit — everyday word
- {該当|がいとう}する: to correspond to, to apply — focuses on meeting criteria
- {適合|てきごう}する: to conform to — more technical, often for standards compliance
